import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

repo = Path('/Users/mohebifar/dev/tsr')
output = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='tsr-published-member-'))
Path('/tmp/tsr-published-member-path').write_text(str(output))

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def files(root):
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)): digest(p.read_bytes())
            for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
            and '.git' not in p.relative_to(root).parts}

def run(args, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(['rtk', 'proxy', *args], cwd=cwd, check=True,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

go = Path('/Users/mohebifar/go/pkg/mod/golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.26.0.darwin-arm64/bin/go')
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
       if not k.startswith(('TSR_', 'TSGO_')) and k not in ('GOFLAGS', 'GOROOT', 'GOMAXPROCS')}
env.update(GOTOOLCHAIN='local', GOPROXY='off', GOSUMDB='off', GOMAXPROCS='2',
           GOCACHE='/tmp/tsr-native-member-completion-cache')
report = {'schema_version': 1, 'issue': 'tsr-1yb.32',
          'source_revision': run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], repo).stdout.decode().strip(),
          'native_revision': run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], repo/'vendor/typescript-go').stdout.decode().strip(),
          'fixture_revision': run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], repo/'vendor/typescript-go/_submodules/TypeScript').stdout.decode().strip(),
          'go_sha256': digest(go.read_bytes()), 'runs': {},
          'runtime_changed': False, 'production_cache_implemented': False,
          'ordinary_cli_replayed': False, 'full_corpora_run': False,
          'speed_claim': False, 'native_ratio_verified': False}

for name, marker, test, count in [
    ('checker-native-shared-property', 'NATIVE_SHARED_PROPERTY ', 'TestNativeSharedPropertyParsedPrograms', 39),
    ('checker-native-recursive-bases', 'NATIVE_RECURSIVE_BASE ', 'TestNativeRecursiveBaseParsedPrograms', 30),
]:
    receipt_path = repo/'docs/architecture'/(name+'.json')
    previous = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    source = Path(previous['setup']['root'])/'source'
    assert source.is_dir()
    before = files(source)
    assert before['internal/checker/checker.go'] == digest((repo/'vendor/typescript-go/internal/checker/checker.go').read_bytes())
    patched = name == 'checker-native-recursive-bases'
    patch = repo/'docs/architecture/checker-native-recursive-bases-probe.patch'
    if patched:
        run(['git', 'apply', '--check', str(patch)], source)
        run(['git', 'apply', str(patch)], source)
    try:
        expected = previous['runs']['restored-qualified']['receipt']
        expected = expected.get('source_hashes_after', expected.get('source_after'))
        actual = files(source)
        assert all(actual.get(k) == v for k, v in expected.items()), name
        command = ['rtk', 'proxy', str(go), 'test', '-p', '1', './internal/checker',
                   '-run', test, '-count=1', '-v', '-timeout', '2m']
        start = time.time()
        with (output/(name+'.stdout')).open('wb') as out, (output/(name+'.stderr')).open('wb') as err:
            process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
            print(json.dumps({'suite': name, 'pid': process.pid}), flush=True)
            returncode = process.wait(timeout=150)
        stdout = (output/(name+'.stdout')).read_text()
        stderr = (output/(name+'.stderr')).read_text()
        observations = [json.loads(line.split(marker, 1)[1]) for line in stdout.splitlines() if marker in line]
        unchanged = actual == files(source)
        report['runs'][name] = {'command': command, 'pid': process.pid,
            'returncode': returncode, 'seconds': time.time()-start,
            'previous_receipt_sha256': digest(receipt_path.read_bytes()),
            'qualified_source_hashes': expected, 'source_unchanged_during_test': unchanged,
            'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr, 'observations': observations,
            'test_forces_native_queries': True, 'ordinary_work_counts': False}
        assert returncode == 0 and unchanged and len(observations) == count, name
    finally:
        if patched:
            run(['git', 'apply', '-R', str(patch)], source)
            for filename in ['native_base_contract.go', 'native_base_contract_test.go']:
                assert not (source/'internal/checker'/filename).exists()
        restored = before == files(source)
        report['runs'].setdefault(name, {})['archive_restored_exactly'] = restored
        report['runs'][name]['baseline_regular_files'] = len(before)
        (output/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
        assert restored, name
print(json.dumps({'output': str(output), 'counts': {k: len(v['observations']) for k, v in report['runs'].items()}}))
